inputs.sbc_source: FY2026 10-K (ACN_Annual_FY2026.txt): cash-flow share-based compensation add-back $2,100.433M (line 3089) PLUS $613.808M of 'Other purchases' -- Class A shares acquired via share withholding for employee payroll-tax obligations on equity-award delivery (Note 14 share-purchase table, line 4299). Accenture publishes no combined figure, so the two lines are summed per the house method. The 2026-09-25 build used the add-back alone because no filing text was extracted then; this is a methodology correction, bridged separately in reconciliation. Withholding was $728.9M in FY2024 and $776.0M in FY2025.
inputs.wacc_rationale: UNCHANGED from 2026-09-25 (base 8.5%, bull 8.0%, bear 9.0%; USD flows, USD rate). Large-cap, investment-grade, net cash; set ~100bp above a pure-quality 7.5-8% baseline for AI-disruption uncertainty to revenue durability. The balance sheet moved (gross debt $5.1B -> $10.1B, net cash $5.0B -> $2.7B) but leverage is still negligible against ~$13B EBITDA, so no change. The per-scenario WACC spread is a prior judgment left alone; note it sits awkwardly with the house 'charge risk once' rule and would be the first thing to revisit in a full rebuild.
inputs.lease_treatment: Single treatment, in the flows: Accenture reports under US GAAP, so operating lease cost is already inside operating income (and therefore inside the EBITDA margin path used here, which is GAAP operating margin + segment D&A). Lease liabilities ($3,285M at 31 Aug 2026) are NOT in net debt. Unchanged from the prior build in substance; the prior note called leases 'not material', which understated them -- they are simply already charged.
inputs.nci_treatment: Deducted once, in the equity bridge. The 2026-09-25 build said 'none -- no minority interests disclosed'; that was wrong. FY2026 net income attributable to noncontrolling interests was $155.8M: $7.9M to Accenture Canada Holdings exchangeable shares (handled by including those 0.579M shares in the diluted count) and $147.9M 'other', primarily Avanade (capitalised at 20x = $2,958M and deducted). Redeemable NCI of $532.8M, new in FY2026 from acquisition put/call options, is deducted at its redemption value. Flows remain consolidated.
inputs.notes: UPDATE of the 2026-09-25 valuation, not a rebuild. Model unchanged: owner-FCF DCF, component build, 10-year horizon, scenario-weighted (dcf-methods routing: operating professional-services company). FY0 rolled from FY2025 to FY2026 on the FY2026 10-K (year ended 31 Aug 2026): revenue $74,183M (+6.5% USD), GAAP operating margin 15.4% (15.8% excluding $308M business-optimization costs), FCF $11,621M. Driver paths were rolled forward one year (old year 2 becomes new year 1) and then re-judged only where the 10-K and the 2026-10-01 FY2027 guidance touch them -- see update_notes for the full changed/unchanged list. FY2027 guidance: revenue +3-6% local currency including acquisitions, GAAP operating margin 15.9-16.1%, diluted EPS $14.39-14.81, FCF $11.0-11.8B, capital returns >= $9.5B, acquisitions ~ $5B. Year-1 check: base FY2027 owner FCF builds to ~$8.4B, which ties to guided FCF midpoint $11.4B less ~$2.9B SBC-incl-withholding less ~$0.36B interest income plus ~$0.2B after-tax interest expense. Net cash ($2.7B) is now well under 1x owner FCF, below the materiality threshold for stripping interest income; it is still stripped, as in the prior build, so that last_fcf stays comparable. FCF CAGRs in historical_growth are on the add-back-plus-interest basis (reported FCF - SBC add-back - interest income) because equity-award withholding is only available for FY2024-FY2026; on that basis FY2026 owner FCF is $9,157M. DATA GAP: ACN_Metrics.csv / core_metrics have NO FY2026 annual or Q4-2026 row (latest is Q3 2026) despite the 2026-11-19 re-export; every FY2026 figure here was read directly from research/ACN/Extracted/ACN_Annual_FY2026.txt. PRICE: regular-session close, not an after-hours print, but the stock fell ~9% over the three sessions to the price date -- treat the upside figure as volatile. Bookkeeping oddity in the prior DCF.json: its price_refresh block (2026-09-28) recorded a price ~47% above the valuation-date price while reporting 0.7% drift; the prior-version price in reconciliation is the valuation-date price from the Drivers file.
inputs.buyback_note: FY2026 financing outflow 'Purchases of shares' $7,521.0M = open-market $6,905.1M (37.46M shares) + equity-award tax withholding $613.8M + exchangeable-share redemptions $2.1M. Up from $4,619.5M in FY2025: management bought heavily into the mid-2026 drawdown, part-funded by $5.0B of new senior notes. Accenture is a funded repurchaser, so the flat count is a fact rather than a convention: period-end shares fell ~4% in FY2026. FY2027 guidance is capital returns of at least $9.5B (about $4.2B dividends at $1.71/quarter, so at least ~$5.3B buybacks); authority was $0.94B at 31 Aug 2026 plus $6.0B approved 30 Sep 2026.
inputs.share_count_basis: Fully diluted at the balance-sheet date, held FLAT because SBC is fully expensed: 668.461M Class A issued less 72.928M treasury = 595.533M outstanding at 31 Aug 2026 (10-K balance sheet), plus 0.579M Accenture Canada Holdings exchangeable shares, 4.090M dilutive employee awards and 0.348M share-purchase-plan shares (FY2026 EPS note) = 600.55M. The FY2026 diluted WEIGHTED average (617.5M) is not used: it lags a count that fell through the year. The 10-K cover shows 590.737M outstanding at 2 Oct 2026 (a further ~4.8M shares bought in September); that count is not used because the cash that bought those shares is still in the 31 Aug balance sheet -- mixing the two would double-count roughly $1B.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: fcf_5yr_cagr (owner-FCF basis), same selection rule as the prior build
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5yr CAGR (10.2%) still runs above revenue (8.0%) and owner-FCF (5.5%) 5yr CAGRs, though the gap narrowed: FY2026 equity grew only 1.5% because $7.5B of buybacks and $4.0B of dividends exceeded net income. Equity CAGR is not used as the anchor. The 3yr owner-FCF CAGR (10.4%) is flattered by a weak FY2023 base and by FY2026 working-capital inflows; the 5yr (5.5%, below reported-FCF 6.7%) is the cleaner read.
historical_growth.notes: End points FY2026 vs FY2023 and FY2021. FY2026 values from the 10-K text (not yet in the Metrics CSV). Owner-FCF series = reported FCF - SBC add-back - interest income for all years; equity-award withholding (FY2024 $729M, FY2025 $776M, FY2026 $614M) is not in the series because earlier years are unavailable. SBC add-back was flat in dollars in FY2026 ($2,100M vs $2,094M) while revenue grew 6.5%, so SBC fell from 3.0% to 2.8% of revenue.

base.narrative: FY2027 guidance is the anchor: revenue +4.5% (midpoint of 3-6% local currency, which includes inorganic contribution from ~$5B of acquisitions; management expects USD and local-currency growth to be about equal) and a GAAP operating margin of 16.0% (EBITDA margin 18.1% after 2.1% D&A). Beyond the guided year the prior judgments stand: growth recovers to ~5% as AI-led reinvention bookings offset Managed Services volatility and federal drag, then fades to 4%; margin is held flat rather than expanded on the AI narrative. The flat level is re-anchored to 17.9% (FY2026's 15.8% operating margin excluding optimization costs), slightly below FY2027 guidance, because management flagged lower pricing in many areas. SBC is charged at 3.65% of revenue falling to 3.3%, now including equity-award tax withholding.

bull.narrative: The record Q4 FY2026 (bookings $22.2B, 141 deals over $100M, book-to-bill 1.2) is the start of a durable reacceleration rather than a catch-up of deals pushed out of Q3: FY2027 lands at the top of guidance (+6%), growth runs 7-8% for several years as enterprises need a scale integrator for agentic AI across the 18 ecosystem partners that already drive ~65% of revenue, and acquired platforms (Dragos, Ookla, Faculty) compound. Margin expands ~1 point beyond guidance to a 19.0% EBITDA margin (16.9% operating) as mix shifts and delivery automation benefits Accenture rather than its clients.

bear.narrative: Q4 FY2026 de-risked one quarter, not the thesis: Managed Services bookings fell ~15% YoY as recently as Q3 FY2026, Accenture stopped disclosing GenAI bookings after Q1 FY2026, and pricing is already lower in many areas. FY2027 is largely booked, so it comes in just under the low end of guidance (+2.5% including acquisitions, margin 40bp short); the damage then shows in FY2028-FY2030 as agentic automation compresses billable hours and clients insource through capability centres -- near-zero growth despite ~$5B/yr of acquisitions, EBITDA margin falling to ~16.3% as pricing gives way and restructuring recurs, exit multiple capped at 12x.

scenario_narratives.base: FY2027 guidance taken at its midpoint (+4.5% revenue, 16.0% operating margin), then growth recovering to ~5% and fading to 4%, with margin held flat at FY2026's underlying level rather than expanding -- AI-led bookings offset Managed Services volatility, federal drag and pricing pressure, but do not re-rate the business.
scenario_narratives.bull: Record Q4 FY2026 bookings mark a durable reacceleration: Accenture is the integrator of choice for agentic AI, growth runs 7-8%, and margin expands about a point beyond guidance as automation benefits Accenture's delivery economics rather than its clients' bills.
scenario_narratives.bear: One strong quarter did not resolve the structural question: FY2027 is mostly booked and lands just under guidance, then automation and insourcing compress billable hours through FY2028-FY2030 -- near-zero growth despite heavy M&A, margin down ~1.5 points, and a 12x exit multiple.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: CHANGED from 30/45/25 to 25/50/25. The prior 30% bear weight rested on two stated legs: a live bookings deterioration (Q3 FY2026) and management cutting guidance mid-year. Both have since been contradicted by reported numbers: FY2026 revenue grew 5% local currency against the cut 3-4% guide, Q4 bookings were a record $22.2B, and FY2027 guidance calls for margin expansion. Bear: trimmed to 25%, not to the 15% house default, because the evidence is one quarter, GenAI metrics are no longer disclosed, and pricing is lower in many areas -- the disruption thesis is de-risked, not refuted. Base: restored to the 50% default with guidance now bracketing it. Bull: held at 25% because it still needs several things to go right at once (sustained bookings, margin beyond guidance, clean integration of ~$10B of acquisitions over two years).

valuation_philosophy.summary: Accenture is a scale-leading professional-services compounder whose 2026 was a round trip: a mid-year collapse on AI-disruption fear and a bookings air-pocket, then a sharp recovery when FY2026 beat its own cut guidance and Q4 bookings set a record. This update takes the FY2026 10-K and FY2027 guidance at face value for the guided year and otherwise leaves the September judgments in place -- growth recovering only to ~5%, margins held flat, a wider-than-default bear weight. Two corrections cut against the improved operating picture: equity-award tax withholding (~$0.6-0.8B a year) is now charged as part of SBC, and the Avanade and acquisition minority interests the prior build missed are deducted. The model's own verdict is modest: on the house basis the stock trades below weighted intrinsic value, but nowhere near the price that would earn a 15% return, and well below the street (SBC-as-non-cash) value.
key_risks_to_valuation: Agentic AI could compress consulting and managed-services labour hours faster or more permanently than any scenario models; one record bookings quarter does not settle this, and GenAI bookings are no longer disclosed
FY2027 guidance of 3-6% includes acquisitions; organic growth is lower than the headline and is not separately guided, so the base case may be crediting purchased growth as durable

About $10B of acquisitions across FY2026-FY2027, part debt-funded (senior notes $5B -> $10B), raises integration and capital-allocation risk; the model gives acquired revenue full margin and charges none of the purchase cash
Terminal value is cap-bound in all three scenarios (16x / 18x / 12x owner FCF), so the valuation is more sensitive to the exit-multiple judgment than to terminal growth

The SBC charge now includes equity-award tax withholding, which tracks the share price at vest rather than revenue; it was $776M in FY2025 and $614M in FY2026, and reversing this treatment would add about $13/share
US federal work (~7% of revenue) remains a drag, and management reports lower pricing in many areas
